sections.title: Headline
sections.content: AI-agent infrastructure dominates today's GitHub momentum: orchestration runtimes, agent-native application frameworks, skills, harnesses, and tool routers occupy most of the top positions. The strongest individual gain is google/ax at +1,542 stars today, while several projects are turning ordinary software into agent-operable systems.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: Agent orchestration and runtimes lead the list; agent-native software and tools are widespread; coding-agent workflows are gaining structure; domain applications extend the trend into finance and productivity. Languages among the 12 entries: Python 5, TypeScript 3, Go 2, Shell 1, JavaScript 1.

sections.title: Notable Shifts
sections.content: The list is less about standalone model releases and more about the surrounding operating layer: orchestration, harnesses, skills, tool routing, and agent-native interfaces. Office, finance, and design projects show the trend broadening into complete software surfaces.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: The leading signal is a maturing agent ecosystem. Developers are investing in the connective tissue that lets agents use tools, follow workflows, and operate inside real applications, with Go, Python, and TypeScript dividing infrastructure, automation, and integration roles.
